visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a brightly lit indoor living room. A young man with dark, curly hair, wearing a plain white t-shirt, sits on a grey couch. He is holding a small green nail clipper and focusing intently on his hands. Behind him, a young woman with dark hair and a white sweater stands looking down at him. Yellow captions and a brand logo are visible in the top corners. (2) The camera cuts to a close-up of the man's hands as he operates the nail clipper. The lighting is bright and even. The woman's face is partially visible in the background as she watches. (3) A sudden transition moves to a woman in a pink button-down shirt dancing energetically in front of a white wall decorated with framed photos. Her hair is tied up in a high bun. She smiles and looks directly at the camera. (4) The woman in the white sweater is shown standing in front of the same wall, looking slightly confused. A yellow flower in a vase sits on a table to the left. The scene is well-lit with soft indoor lighting. (5) A split-screen or rapid cut sequence shows the woman in pink looking upside down through her legs toward the camera, followed by the woman in white doing the same. Their facial expressions shift from curiosity to exaggerated shock. (6) In a bedroom setting, a woman with blonde and pink highlights, wearing a purple crop top and denim shorts, is seen smoothing out a large poster of a pop group on her wall. She looks around the room with a nervous expression. (7) A young man in a blue shirt is in a bedroom with vibrant orange and yellow decor. He pulls a yellow checkered blanket over himself as he lies on a bed with two white pillows. He pauses and looks at the extra pillow next to him. (8) He quickly removes the extra pillow and lies down again. Suddenly, the woman in the white sweater is lying right next to him in the spot where the pillow was, staring at him with a deadpan expression. The man looks terrified.
